answer: Start from proof of elapsed time in a TEE. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. Cloning 454 keys multiplies the price 454-fold: 41768 POA locked, or 7718 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. One nectar of signal, one terrace of cost, one raven of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
